answer.main_body: wooden fence post and horizontal rails
answer.evidence: The fence rails are drawn in pure front elevation with simple 1-2px edge highlights rather than visible top faces. The frame rule explicitly requires horizontal beams to show top surfaces.

answer.main_body: wooden post with cap and two horizontal rails
answer.evidence: The post cap (rows 2-5) and shaft (rows 6-15) are shaded purely as vertical cylinders with side-to-side lighting and a flat top outline at row 1, showing no foreshortened top surface. The rails are drawn flat from the front as in a side-scroller.

The post cap top surface is clearly visible from above across rows 2–4 (3 rows tall), and the horizontal rails show distinct lighter top surfaces (rows 6–7 and 11–12) above darker south-facing front surfaces.
